ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a target origin, authorized scope and the unapproved-target flag are declared; it does not run a scan.
offer: Dynamic security testing needs a specifically authorized target and path scope. A declared target does not prove a live scan; missing scanner or credentials must remain visible.

minimal.reason: Declare the target origin the scan is authorized for. A scanner without a target cannot run, so state the origin.

mid.reason: Declare the authorized path scope. Scanning outside the scope is unauthorized, so list the allowed paths.

maximal.reason: Set scanning unapproved targets to false. Only specifically authorized targets may be scanned, so keep the list explicit.
